Associate Professor in the Department of Economics at [HEC Montréal](https://www.hec.ca/en/profs/amine.ouazad.html), Canada.

___
::: columns

:::: {.column width="80%"}
> <p> I am an urban and real estate economist with interests in microeconomic theory, applied microeconomics, and mortgage finance. [Email me](mailto:amine.ouazad@hec.ca). </p>
> <p> 📍 I served on the [scientific](https://www.areuea.org/international) and [awards committees](https://www.areuea.org/awards-committee) of the American Real Estate and Urban Economics Association, and the scientific committee of the [Urban Economics Association](https://urbaneconomics.org/meetings/). My research was cited in [Congressional hearings](https://youtu.be/c9lrud-Uaok?t=2610), in the Financial Times, Wall Street Journal, [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2024/12/07/business/economy/mortgages-climate-risk-fannie-freddie.html), CBS, Bloomberg, Politico, etc. Previously I was an associate professor at Ecole polytechnique, France, an associate professor at Rutgers Business School, New Jersey, and an assistant professor at INSEAD, Fontainebleau. I have taught over 5,000 students in Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, France, Singapore, in the EMBA, MBA, LLM, PhD, MSc, BComm, and BSc undergraduate programs. </p>
> <p> 📍 Securitization and Climate Risk: Replicable repository with public data, [GitHub Repo](https://github.com/aouazad/Ouazad_Kahn_2022). Read the substack for context: [Climate Change is the New Tobacco](https://policyandthemarkets.substack.com/p/climate-change-is-the-new-tobacco). </p>
> <p> 📍 Equilibrium Multiplicity: A Systematic Approach using Homotopies, with an Application to Chicago is Revise and Resubmit at the <i>Journal of Political Economy</i>.
> <p> 📍 Adaptation Using Financial Markets: Climate Risk Diversification Through Securitization is Revise and Resubmit at <i>Management Science</i> [Link](https://www.nber.org/papers/w32244). </p> [Paper](https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=4699361). </p>
>  <p> 📍 "The Eye of the Beholder: Neighborhood Embeddings and House Prices,"  [link to HEC Paris slides](https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/rc1i9ggxq36s4bjlrqxqa/slides_HEC26.pdf?rlkey=c6ru5f0ymbl7kidpkubstis5h&dl=1), with coauthors Laurent Gobillon (Paris), Clément Gorin (Paris), Stephan Heblich (Toronto). </p>
> <p> 📍 Presented "The Workings of a City: The Response to Flood in a Coastal Megacity", joint with Tom Bearpark (Exeter), Ashwin Rode (Chicago), Vaidehi Tandel (Manchester) at the Indian Institute of Management, Bengalore [link](https://www.iimb.ac.in/node/898). </p>
> <p> 📍  Presented the new version of "Time Consistent Infrastructure Investments: Optimal Flood Protection Policies in Spatial Equilibrium", discussed by Meredith Fowlie and discussed her paper at the Toronto Climate Economics Meeting, organized by Stephan Heiblich. [Paper](https://www.nber.org/papers/w33333) [Slides](https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/c5h2ehppfg4hogh3toz6u/presentation_short.pdf?rlkey=khbdo43012pr9vigzkfb9u473&st=bb79q732&dl=0). </p>
